description: Reporting date. Daily rows from 2020-01-05 to 2024-08-04; WHO-sourced totals are updated once a week (Sundays), so values stay the same between updates.
Country or territory name as used by Our World in Data (234 countries/territories). Regional and income-group aggregates such as World and Europe were removed.
Cumulative number of laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 cases reported up to this date (OWID total_cases). Daily new cases = difference from the previous row of the same country.
Cumulative number of deaths attributed to COVID-19 reported up to this date (OWID total_deaths).

ESTIMATED cumulative recoveries: confirmed cases 14 days earlier minus deaths to date (minimum 0). OWID/WHO do not publish recoveries, so this column is derived and should not be treated as an official figure.

Cumulative number of people who received at least one vaccine dose (OWID people_vaccinated). Last reported value carried forward; 0 before the country's first report; empty for 21 territories that never reported (about 9% of rows).
Population of the country used by OWID (UN World Population Prospects, 2022 estimate). Constant for each country and used for per-million and percentage calculations.
Continent of the country: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania or South America. Constant for each country.
